body:
The diff count looks nice :)

Have you measured binary size and performance effects?

Binary size is mostly unaffected, fluctuating between +- 1 MB depending on type (per CI download size; confirmed it correlates to uncompressed sizes for Windows editor/template).

Regarding performance, my workstation is quite noisy, and I don't have a reliable setup for performance testing. I will try to set something up for testing, but if someone has a known reliable setup, they are more than welcome to test it and report their results (more machines are always better, after all).
